description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 04 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 04 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves legal modifications to financial legislation, specifically changing budget allocations and expenditure limits. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it deals with statutory instruments and amendments to existing laws.
